posts.cooked:
Yes, I'm aware that I'm logged in now =p.

 

Here's the deal,  I can log into my account,  but whenever I attempt to navigate from the login page to say, the forum page, it immidiately logs me out again.  Essentially, this means I can't log in.

 

Currently I'm backdooring it by going to my page, then one of my own threads, than back to the >G rules forum, which works for some reason.   Then I created a new topic and rerouted it to General Discussion.     However this is not practical to do for the long haul, nor can I really read new topics or get to any forum that isn't the rules forum... at least not with my account, though I can still view pages as a guest.

 

This has happened before, but then it was fixed.   I think with the recent forum restructuring it has started happening again.   Thought I would let people know so it can be fixed again (hopefully)

 

-awp
